name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Comiket Hen~
original_name: しょうじょのみちくさ～コミケへん～
source:
Cute innocent young girls are lost in the maze of Comiket. How exactly will you help them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]

你究竟要怎样帮助她们？
